games.title: Language Choice
games.description: Choose the form that makes the unit language accurate.

rounds.prompt: Which word names something you find in your classroom?
rounds.explanation: A whiteboard is in the classroom; a camel, a river and a cloud are all found outside.

rounds.prompt: Which classroom thing do you sit on?
rounds.explanation: We sit on a chair; a book is for reading, a clock shows the time and a ruler helps us measure.

rounds.prompt: Which classroom thing tells you the time?
rounds.explanation: A clock shows the time; a crayon colours, a table holds our work and a door opens and closes.

rounds.prompt: Which word begins with the same sound as book?
rounds.explanation: Book and bag both start with /b/; pen starts with /p/, cup with /k/ and mat with /m/.

rounds.prompt: What do you say to your teacher when you arrive at school in the morning?
rounds.explanation: We greet people in the morning with Good morning; good night and goodbye are for leaving.

rounds.explanation: At the door Amal says, 'I am six years old.'

rounds.prompt: Amal spoke softly. Does softly mean loudly or quietly?

rounds.prompt: What green thing did Amal find in the treasure hunt?

rounds.prompt: How did Amal feel when Adam asked to be her friend?

rounds.prompt: Which talk line do you use to tell somebody your name?

games.description: Reveal tiles and connect each word with its meaning.

rounds.prompt: Match vocabulary set 1.
pairs: hat
Something you wear on your head to keep warm or shady.
ran
Ran means moved fast on your legs, and it already happened.
tap
A tap lets water come out when you turn it.

rounds.prompt: Match vocabulary set 2.
pairs: house
A house is the building where a family lives.
pencil
A thin wooden stick we write and draw with.
I
A small word you use when you talk about yourself.

rounds.prompt: Match vocabulary set 3.
pairs: no
This word means not any. It is the opposite of yes.
hello
Hello is a friendly word we say when we meet someone.
happy
Happy means you feel good and want to smile.

rounds.prompt: Match vocabulary set 4.
pairs: asked
Asked means you spoke to find out something.
audio
Audio is sound that you can listen to, like a voice or music.
luck
Luck is when good things happen without you trying.

rounds.prompt: Match vocabulary set 5.
pairs: counted
Counted means you said numbers one after another.
clock
A round face with hands that tells us the time.
green
The colour of grass and of leaves on a tree.

rounds.prompt: Match vocabulary set 6.
pairs: pink
A light colour made from red and white, like a flower.
read
To look at words and understand what they say.
room
A space inside a house with walls, a floor and a door.
